name: coauthor
description: A coordinated multi-agent system for empirical research papers. Claude Code is the coordinator you converse with; a diverse OpenRouter debate panel (Proposer, Adversary) generates and attacks ideas; tool-using Claude subagents ground the work in fact (Verifier over litdb), independently build the data and run the empirics (Analyst), and independently re-derive both the data build and the results (Replicator). Domain-specific data access lives in a separate data plugin. Runs in any directory, keeping everything in a local .coauthor/ folder; creates no repos.
